scope: Full municipal-wastewater screening analysis with nonmunicipal extension register. Mixed source vintages; no measured 2026 national recovery forecast. Water reuse/sales excluded.

nutrients.additionality: NOT_ESTABLISHED; existing nutrient reuse not fully subtracted.

nutrient_valuation.scope: Gross retail nutrient replacement value. Includes existing recovery; not incremental profit, import savings, plant-gate sales or a guaranteed buyer price.

disposal_P_subset.scope: Subset of gross sewage P above; do not add. Recovery is conditional, not a measured future output.
disposal_P_subset.value_limit: Subset of gross P value, not additive. Excludes N/Mg coproduct credits, all costs and product availability differences.

struvite_illustration.limits: Alternative product route. N is included in overall nitrogen quantity; Mg is a reagent/feed requirement, not extra output. Added reagent mass is not recovered native waste mass. No struvite is additionally counted over recovered P.
struvite_illustration.value_limit: P+N reference equivalent only, not observed struvite sales price; no premium or Mg credit assigned. Already included in P/N valuation.

legacy_HTL_disposal_savings_reference.basis: Linear scaling of an older national-model estimate only (S33). Not a current measured baseline; excluded from all margins and product totals.

CHP.limits: Gross historic resource deployment, not additional net recovery. Retail-average electricity is a proxy; only avoidable bill components qualify. Useful heat assumes a matched sink. Capital budgets are assumptions; full project costs need site engineering. Existing generation/heat use and costs are not known.

RNG.limits: Alternative to burning the same gas in CHP. Upgrading, compression, grid connection, methane slip, O&M and capex must be priced; environmental credits excluded. U.S. is a net gas exporter.

HTL.limits: Alternative raw-sludge route to full AD potential. Finished volume yield and diesel split are explicit assumptions, not national engineering outputs. Upgrading H2/energy, transport, rejects, aqueous treatment, catalysts and capex missing. No credit revenue assumed.

accounting_rules: 25/50/75 nutrient fractions are net qualified-output assumptions; energy fractions are deployment shares of dated gross literature potentials, not equivalent recovery technology efficiencies.
No total annual profit is reported. Product replacement value, plant-gate receipts, avoided costs and policy credits are different accounts.
AD-CHP, AD-RNG and full-sludge HTL are alternatives here. A hybrid requires a separate explicit carbon/mass balance.
Struvite N is inside total recovered N; do not add it or charge separate nitrogen-recovery costs to it. Mg reagent costs belong in the P route.
CHP parasitic electricity is deducted once; heat reserved for internal process loads is not externally sold. Do not value the methane again after converting it to heat and power.
Heat pumps consume electricity; do not count delivered heat as recovered source energy alone.
Existing land application, generation, heat, products and baseline costs must be subtracted for additionality. Avoided expense must not be duplicated across nutrient and sludge trains.

Imported nutrient content, gross electricity/gas volumes and diesel volumes are physical comparisons, not verified monetary trade-deficit reductions. Net gas exports and electricity transmission constraints matter.
Old sludge composition times partial reported dry mass is a context proxy. Unknown qualified recovery/value is null, never zero-filled.
Water reuse volume and sales value remain excluded; thermal energy is a separate resource account.
Contaminants capture, soil-use clearance and destruction are distinct. No autonomous approvals, soil safety or emissions clearance inferred.
No speculative deuterium fuel sales, carbon-credit revenue or critical-metal revenue included.
